_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro: Ị na-egwu Golf (Card Game) - Player {player_id}. Ihe mgbaru ọsọ: Nweta akara kachasị dị ala na nke a. Ọ bụrụ na ogidi nwere otu uru, a na-agbakọta ha dị ka 0. Kaadị Kaadị: A = 1, 2-10 = ọnụ ahịa ọnụ, J / Q = 10, K = 0 Omume (jiri ezigbo brackets): - '[draw]' - Dọrọ site na oche - '[take]' - Were site na ikpochapụ ikpo - '[swap X Y]' - Gbanwee kaadị a dọtara na ọnọdụ X (ahịrị) Y (ogidi) - '[discard]' - Wepụ kaadị ahụ dọtara

board.drew: Ị dọtara: {card} Ugbu a ị ga- [swap X Y] ma ọ bụ [discard] ya.
board.took:
Ị were: {card} site na ọkpụkpụ efu
Ị ga-eme [swap X Y] na ya (enweghị ike ịhapụ).

options.final_turns: Oge ikpeazụ! Nhọrọ gị: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Ị ga: [swap X Y] (enweghị ike ịtụfu kaadị site na ikpochapụ ikpo)
options.swap_or_discard: Ị ga-emerịrị: [swap X Y] ma ọ bụ [discard]

action_desc.swapped: Onye na-egwu egwu {pid} gbanwere {new} na {old} na ọnọdụ ({row},{col})

message.deck_empty: Okpokoro ahụ tọgbọ chakoo! Egwuregwu ahụ na-agwụ ozugbo.
message.knocked: Onye ọkpụkpọ {pid} kụrụ! Onye ọkpụkpọ ọ bụla ọzọ na-enweta otu ntụgharị ọzọ.
message.final_round: Onye ọkpụkpọ {pid} {reason}! Onye ọkpụkpọ ọ bụla ọzọ na-enweta otu ntụgharị ọzọ.

invalid.need_drawn_discard: Ị ga-achọ kaadị e sere ese iji tụfuo ya.

summary.full: Egwuregwu Agwụla! Onye ọkpụkpọ {winner} na-emeri na akara nke {score} isi! Akara ikpeazụ: {scores}
